subject: Final-mile node commitment readiness for Velaris (soft hold request)
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Kuznetsova <anya@velaris.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Nov 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final-mile node commitment readiness for Velaris (soft hold request)

Team —

Velaris (Anya copied) is in the last stage of procurement and has signaled they will execute within the next 2–3 weeks pending a final SOW and a small upfront commitment. They need a short-duration, narrowly scoped capacity hold to guarantee latency and throughput for the POC-to-prod ramp.

High level ask: can we place a 30–45 day soft hold on the following fleet mix (US region) and confirm which node IDs would be reserved so Velaris can map their workload?

- 4 x A100 80GB (single-tenant, dedicated GPU nodes)
- 12 x A100 40GB (pooled, burstable)
- Network egress within existing enterprise quota (no special burst)

Constraints: hold should allow automatic release if no signed SOW or deposit by 2029-12-20. Also request a quick note on whether thermal binning or rack affinity would impact placement in our east-coast clusters.

Attachments: velaris_capacity_specs.xlsx (specs Velaris sent) — I uploaded it to the deal record.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ops confirms node availability and proposes an expiration date for the soft hold
2) Sales (Marcus) confirms whether we need to surface any pricing adjustments for dedicated A100-80 usage during the hold
3) I will ask Velaris to provide a purchase order or deposit to formalize the hold

Thanks — short timeline so appreciate quick turnaround.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Kuznetsova <anya@velaris.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Nov 2029 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final-mile node commitment readiness for Velaris (soft hold request)

Dev / team —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick summary of current capacity in us-east-1 cluster that can satisfy this:

Available for soft reservation (capacity snapshot at 2029-11-11 11:00 PST):
- A100-80 dedicated: node-ue1-8234, node-ue1-8239, node-ue1-8241, node-ue1-8246 (4 nodes)
- A100-40 pooled: node-ue1-9401 .. node-ue1-9416 (16 nodes, we can earmark 12)

Thermal/rack notes: the four A100-80 nodes are split across two racks (reduces correlated failure risk). No known thermal binning issues — these nodes are in nominal bins for sustained token throughput.

I can place a soft hold on those node IDs now if we agree on the hold terms below:
- Hold window: 2029-11-13 to 2029-12-23 (40 days)
- Conditions to keep hold beyond expiration: signed SOW + 30% deposit or an explicit written extension from sales
- Hold type: soft hold (prevent reallocation to new customers but allow emergency preemption for critical infra incidents)

I'll attach a one-page node mapping and a short ops note on the hold semantics. If sales wants a hard escrow (absolute lock with billing implications) we need cross-functional signoff and finance approval.

Attachments: node-mapping-velaris.pdf

Please confirm and I will push the hold and update the reservation tracker.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Capacity Planning Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Anya Kuznetsova <anya@velaris.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Velaris Enterprise <enterprise@velaris.ai>, finance@velaris.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2029 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final-mile node commitment readiness for Velaris (soft hold request)

Dev / Hannah —

Thanks for the quick response and the node IDs. Two quick questions from our side:

1) Can you confirm whether the A100-80 nodes will be co-located (same AZ) or spread across AZs? Our deployment automation prefers same-AZ for the latency-sensitive inference cluster.
2) What, if any, is the pricing delta if we request those 4 A100-80 nodes be converted to a hard escrow for the hold window? We are prepared to provide a refundable deposit if that simplifies things.

Also — can you include the expected sustained token throughput per A100-80 node (we need to calibrate our estimators against your runbook)?

If possible please include the ops note inline when you push the hold so our SRE team can reconcile the node IDs with their IaC.

Best,
Anya Kuznetsova
Head of Platform | Velaris AI
anya@velaris.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 2029 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final-mile node commitment readiness for Velaris (soft hold request)

Quick internal decision and next steps —

I approve placing the soft hold per Hannah's terms (2029-11-13 to 2029-12-23). We will offer the customer an option to convert to a hard escrow for the 4 A100-80 nodes at a +18% premium to standard dedicated pricing for the hold window (covers operational opportunity cost + small deposit refund admin). If Velaris chooses hard escrow they need to sign the SOW and remit the 30% refundable deposit by 2029-11-20 to lock the nodes.

Hannah — please push the soft hold and include the inline ops note and sustained throughput estimate (~3.2–4.0M tokens/hour sustained per A100-80 under our standard tight-loop inference profile). Tag finance for a provisional invoice (cc finance@redwood.com) and I will send Velaris the SOW addendum and deposit instructions.

Stephanie — loop in legal/finance on standard escrow wording; keep me posted if we need to escalate.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
